pr_title: core: propagate stop too if restart is issued
pr_body:
The restart of a unit should also be considered as that a stop job happens, and thus gets propagated to units specified using `PropagatesStopTo=`.

Fixes #24068

issue_context.title: PropagatesStopTo= does not propagate on restart
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

250.3-8.fc36

### Used distribution

Fedora 36

### Linux kernel version used

5.17.5-300.fc36.x86_64

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

systemctl, systemd, other

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

When a unit with `PropagatesStopTo=` is restarted (i.e. via `systemctl restart`), the service that is supposed to receive the stop propagation is not stopped. The "stop" portion of the restart request is not propagated as expected.

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

The unit that is the target of the stop propagation is unaffected.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Create two units:
    * foo.service
        ```systemd
        [Unit]
        Wants=bar.service
        After=bar.service
        PropagatesStopTo=bar.service

        [Service]
        ExecStartPre=echo start foo
        ExecStart=sleep infinity
        ExecStopPost=echo stopped foo
        ```
    * bar.service
        ```systemd
        [Service]
        ExecStartPre=echo start bar
        ExecStart=sleep infinity
        ExecStopPost=echo stopped bar
        ```
1. Start both services: `systemctl start foo.service`
2. Restart foo: `systemctl restart foo.service`
3. Notice that the logs for foo show it was stopped, but bar continues running and does not stop. The expectation is that foo stopping would cause bar to stop, and then foo starting would cause bar to start due to the `Wants=` dependency, meaning a restart of foo should result in a restart of bar.

### Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue

```sh
[zeffron@fedora ~]$ journalctl -u foo.service --since -1m
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora systemd[1]: Starting foo.service...
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora echo[1620]: start foo
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora systemd[1]: Started foo.service.
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora systemd[1]: Stopping foo.service...
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora echo[1627]: stopped foo
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora systemd[1]: foo.service: Deactivated successfully.
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora systemd[1]: Stopped foo.service.
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora echo[1628]: start foo
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora systemd[1]: Starting foo.service...
Jul 20 17:06:19 fedora systemd[1]: Started foo.service.

[zeffron@fedora ~]$ journalctl -u bar.service --since -1m
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora systemd[1]: Starting bar.service...
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora echo[1622]: start bar
Jul 20 17:06:15 fedora systemd[1]: Started bar.service.
```
